limitations: Six full3D meshes freeze the original14916/15979-tetrahedron polyhedra and refine by uniform edge midpoints, without CAD projection. Existing volume/area/COM checks pass at original1e-12 budgets. Ten original five-case reference fields are freshly requalified, exact nodal loads and original complete field/probe budgets retained. Zero new fine equilibrium states are counted by these setup/qualification runs. Volume/surface basis and boundary quadrature still refine together; this is not a pure volume-only or physical-convergence claim and does not replace any original eight-level CAD curve. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
